description: WP-M4a DROP POD ASSAULT. Fixture sm11e_m4a_drop_pod (battle round 1, P1 Movement): the Drop Pod is in strategic reserves with Intercessors embarked. It is listed among the round-1 arrivals and set up (PLACE_REINFORCEMENT); the new sm11e_drop_pod_landed window offers the Drop Pod Assault card, a real click starts the assault-disembark follow-up (DisembarkDialog, assault mode) and a set-up within 8" of the Boyz is refused.

steps.comment: decline any other open window (not under test)
Drop Pod Assault: the Drop Pod may arrive in the first battle round
the Drop Pod is set up (ingress move, round 1)
REAL click: Drop Pod Assault - the embarked Intercessors disembark
setup privilege: the Boyz are moved ~6" from the set-up ring for this check only (restored after); the same set-up is refused within 8" (Drop Pod Assault) and valid once the Boyz are back

steps.script: ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("Drop Pod Assault: the units embarked within")

steps.comment: clean debug log: no ERROR line was written during the scenario
